note: USeqAct_Interp::UpdateInterpLoop - both wraps of the matinee clock in one function: bLooping's whole-sequence rewind and a SoireeControl key's rewind to its own segment. Returns TRUE when a non-looping matinee ran off its end, which is what makes StepInterp call Stop()
USeqAct_Interp::SoireeShouldLoop - walks every group instance's track instances and asks the first SoireeControl one whose track update pass is 0
USeqAct_Interp::SoireeLoopShouldBackupTransforms - the same walk, asking instead whether a key just crossed starts a loop
USeqAct_Interp::SoireeLoopBackupActorTransforms - GroupInst->m_ActorSavedPosition/Rotation for a group with bBackupTransformOnLoop
USeqAct_Interp::SoireeLoopRestoreActorTransforms - SetRotation then SetLocation from the saved pair
USeqAct_Interp::GetDistractionLoopOverride - m_OverrideDistractionLoop by FName, -1 when absent

(unnamed in both PDBs) StepInterp's per-track-instance NeedsSynchronizing walk. The group-level synchronizing early-out is NOT ported - two Arkane virtuals, UInterpGroupInst slot 320 and UInterpGroup slot 292, both ICF-folded to `xor eax,eax; ret`, behind a bit this tree never sets

USeqAct_Interp::StepInterp - retail's shape: PlayRate step, BlendOutTimeOverride reset, the synchronizing walk, UpdateInterpLoop, UpdateInterp, Stop, UpdateStreamingForCameraCuts. The reference's inline bLooping wrap and its ReplicatedActor tail are gone (ReplicatedActor is a storage-less shim and retail has no such block)

USeqAct_Interp::UpdateOp - the head only: ActivatedLinks resized to InputLinks and OR'd with each link's bHasImpulse. Sticky, because the five known impulses are consumed in the same call. This is how a Kismet impulse on a Soiree pin survives to be read
UInterpTrackInstSoireeControl::InitTrackInst - one status entry per key, each carrying the index of the matinee input link named "SCT_" + the key's pin
UInterpTrackInstSoireeControl::SoireeShouldLoop - the segment [StartTime, StartTime+KeyLength] replayed m_LoopCount times, 0 meaning until broken
UInterpTrackInstSoireeControl::SoireeStartLoop - the last key crossed becomes the active one
UInterpTrackInstSoireeControl::NeedsSynchronizing - refreshes every key's broken flag from the matinee's ActivatedLinks, then the Pause hold and the break-immediately jump
UInterpTrackSoireeControl::GetKeyframeLength - 0 for a Pause key, KeyLength for a Loop key
UInterpTrackSoireeControl::GetTimeRange
UInterpTrackInst::GetMatinee - Outer of Outer
the "SCT_" prefix the pin name is matched with (a file-scope FString in retail, read at 0x506c83). Measured: the menu's key pin is 'Loop' and the matinee's sixth input link is 'SCT_Loop'

UDisGFxMoviePlayerGlobal::PreRender - the mouse read from the viewport, mapped into movie space, the cursor attached and moved. Reconstructed in the GFxUI bring-up, not on UDisGFxMoviePlayerGlobal, because UDisGlobalUIManager never runs here
UDisGFxMoviePlayerGlobal::ConditionalShowMouseCursor - _root.mouseCursor_mc.attachMovie("mouseCursor", "mouseCursorInst", getNextHighestDepth())
UDisGFxMoviePlayerGlobal::MoveMouseCursor - SetDisplayInfo with _x and _y only
UDisGFxMoviePlayerGlobal::ConditionalHideMouseCursor - the removeMovieClip arm; the bring-up drops the GFxValue instead when the global movie is gone
UDisGFxMoviePlayerBase::ComputeMovieSpaceInfo - screen size, movie size, the scale and the empty space on the short axis
FGFxEngine::InitKeyMap - the five mouse bindings of retail's KeyCodes map: LeftMouseButton 0, RightMouseButton 1, MiddleMouseButton 2, MouseScrollUp 4, MouseScrollDown 3, all with key code 0

FGFxEngine::InputKey - the mouse arm: a key-code-0 binding becomes MouseDown/MouseUp at the engine's MousePos, or MouseWheel with ScrollDelta 6*MouseButton-21, and the entry remembers which movie took the press

FGFxEngine::InputAxis - the non-gamepad arm: HudViewport->GetMousePos, minus the movie's own viewport origin, delivered as a MouseMove. The gamepad axis-emulation arm is not reconstructed (this tree's UpdateKeyEmulation is a no-op)

UGameViewportClient::GetCursor - retail returns MC_None in the normal case, so the Windows arrow is hidden and the game draws its own. This tree already does the same through bDisplayHardwareMouseCursor being FALSE; nothing changed

(unnamed in both PDBs) StepInterp's jumped-forward notify: GetGroupActor per group, and if it is a pawn, its vtable slot 1220 with the group instance. No SoireeControl key reaches it and the menu's matinees have no pawn
USeqAct_Interp::UpdateMatineeLOD - the first line of retail's StepInterp; absent from this tree

GFx_GenerateMouseButtonEvents - the per-mouse-index topmost-entity tracking that turns a mouse position into rollOver/rollOut/press/release on a button. Without it a click has no notion of which menu entry it is over
